verdict.rationale: E2B has a dedicated first-party docs page for lifecycle-event webhooks, which deliver notifications to an external web server when sandbox lifecycle events occur. That is a documented outbound HTTP callback a programmatic consumer can receive. The pack offers only this one excerpt, and the events shown are limited to sandbox lifecycle. Missing for 10: registration/subscription API details, the list of event types, payload signing and retry semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
